reproduction.rationale: Both information conditions must reconstruct the same original WFCI1/WFCI2 and thirteen-session fUS findings and companion controls, with official author code as the sole added resource. Exact acquisition/session identities, original five-fold widefield and ten-fold fUS membership, preprocessing, complete neural/behavior predictions and source metric reductions remain unresolved. CEBRA whole-trial labels must remain distinct from SBIND fixation-sample supervision, and the original eight-direction axial AUC path is not established by a categorical-accuracy utility. Missing table rows and sixteen ambiguous spread definitions remain required. Published table values are allowed paper inputs and cannot demonstrate computation; a complete submitted-analysis interface and independent granular-output verifier are absent. Authentic common input delivery, code-only separation, exposure and distribution permissions, and matched cumulative budgets are not frozen, so no paired protocol is specified.

improvement.rationale: Both information conditions must preserve the complete original WFCI1/WFCI2 and thirteen-session fUS prediction task, source folds, full neural fields, behavior channels, comparators and ablations, with official author code as the sole added resource. Authentic common inputs, method-specific supervision, original masks/weighting, complete candidate and matched author-baseline predictions, and their independent granular derivation are not authenticated. A corrected whole-trial split is an extension and cannot substitute for the original folds. The full-vector improvement/noninferiority rule, justified uncertainty, permitted attempts and matched cumulative budgets remain unresolved. Public paper/table exposure and data/code delivery permissions require matched manifests; existing owner-side metric kernels establish neither access separation nor scientific execution. No pairing protocol or improvement result is specified.
